notes.title: Patch for Loading Saves & an Achievement
notes.notes:
Hello everyone~

We have a new patch to fixes a couple issues! 
[list]
[*] The issue with loading saves starting the game from the beginning
[*] "The Greatest Shinobi" achievement was having issues unlocking when playing on normal
[/list]

Thank you!

notes.title: Patch for Sudden Crashes
notes.notes:
Hello everyone~

The developers have put together a quick patch to fix the sudden crashes that people have been having!

Thank you to everyone who has made reports, the info was very helpful! Let us know if you are still getting the crashes.

Hopefully, we can the fixes for the issues people are experiencing quickly as well.

notes.title: Introducing Vert and Miyabi!
notes.notes:
Hello! We’re excited to showcase some new images for our playable character Vert and Miyabi.

• Neptunia™ x SENRAN KAGURA: Ninja Wars is an Action RPG/Hack n' Slash. You play as a ninja girl who happens to be a personified game console that is fighting to determine who has the strongest ninja arts.

Many obstacles awaits the player, but by training for new skills, crafting new weapons, and gaining new ninja partners you will be able to discover the true ways of the ninja arts and defeat the evil that lurks behind the scenes.
